findings.finding: Core Runtime already owns executable Contract, Schema, Version and baseline Migration declarations.
findings.decision: PWS-I2 must reference them and must not replace or absorb them.

findings.finding: No Universal PWS Registry Schema, Version Store, Relationship Store, Restriction Store, Audit Store, Event Outbox or Registry Query API exists.
findings.decision: Create only in PWS-I2-W1 after this audit; do not represent the existing content index as universal.

findings.finding: Core Runtime persistence has a nine-method contract and memory, local and D1 drivers.
findings.decision: Reuse its infrastructure boundary where compatible; do not make PWS-I2 a new Runtime persistence owner.

findings.finding: One production D1 binding and four immutable executable migrations already exist.
findings.decision: Any future Registry tables require a new sequential migration; existing SQL and checksums remain immutable.

findings.finding: Twenty non-executable Core Runtime schema baseline declarations coexist with four executable D1 SQL migrations.
findings.decision: Keep both, but distinguish schema baseline declarations from executable storage migrations in PWS-I2.

findings.finding: Runtime, account, professional, financial and external-reader projections exist independently; there is no Universal Registry Read Model or Query API.
findings.decision: PWS-I2-W1 may add registry-specific reads without merging customer or professional projections.

findings.finding: content/registry contains 110 JSON files while content/registry/index.json lists 48; 61 files are outside the index after excluding index.json.
findings.decision: Treat index.json as a legacy content index, not a complete Registry inventory.

findings.finding: PKR Knowledge data and schemas form an independent canonical knowledge source.
findings.decision: PWS-I2 registers published asset and deliverable types only; it must not duplicate Canonical Knowledge Nodes.

findings.finding: Professional Service, Offer, Pricing, Book Product and specialist Registries are spread across content JSON and executable JavaScript.
findings.decision: Record source authority and compatibility before any migration; preserve current reads and writes until the owning W2-W7 step.

findings.finding: Book product fields are duplicated in content/registry/book-products.json and functions/commerce/book-product-registry.js; service and offer concepts overlap across multiple legacy catalogs.
findings.decision: PWS-I2 must select one canonical write source and retain explicit read adapters; no silent deletion or bulk rewrite.
